in_sanskrit.name: स्वयम्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: derived from the root 'swa' meaning 'self' or 'own' and the suffix 'yam' which forms the masculine noun. The full meaning of 'Swayam' is 'self-existent' or 'self-created'.

in_hindi.name: स्वयम
in_hindi.long_meaning: In Hindi, 'Swayam' translates to 'one's own, self, or self-created'. It can also mean 'arrogant' or 'proud'.

in_tamil.name: ஸ்வயம்
in_tamil.long_meaning: In Tamil, 'Swayam' translates to 'one's own will, autonomy, or self-created'.

in_telugu.name: శ్వయమ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: In Telugu, 'Swayam' translates to 'self-existent, independent, or self-created'.

in_marathi.name: Swayam
in_marathi.long_meaning: Swayam हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The one who is self-controlled, self-dependent, and self-sufficient.

in_bengali.name: Swayam
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Self, Independent
in_bengali.long_meaning: Swayam একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The one who is self-controlled, self-dependent, and self-sufficient.
